GradCafe Analytics Documentation

GradCafe Analytics is a Flask-based application for collecting, cleaning, storing, and analyzing graduate admissions data.

The Module 4 version includes automated testing, database dependency injection, continuous integration through GitHub Actions, and Sphinx-generated source documentation.

Project Features

  • GradCafe data collection and scraping

  • PostgreSQL database storage using SQLAlchemy

  • Flask-based analytics webpage

  • LLM-assisted program and university standardization

  • Automated Pytest test suite

  • 100 percent source-code test coverage

  • GitHub Actions continuous integration
